chunks: Ibn Abī Naṣr narrated from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man married a woman according to her determination, then he died before she could determine it.
He عليه السلام said: She has no dowry, but she inherits from him.

key_terms.تَرِثُهُ: She inherits from him as his wife.
key_terms.تَزَوَّجَ ٱمْرَأَةً بِحُكْمِهَا: He married a woman on terms that the determination was left to her judgment.
key_terms.صَدَاقٌ: Dowry due to the wife in marriage.

ai.seo_question: If a husband dies before an unspecified dowry is determined, does the wife receive the dowry and inherit from him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a marriage in which the dowry was left to the woman's later determination, but the husband died before that occurred. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that she does not receive a ṣadāq in this case, while her right of inheritance from the husband remains established.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5673 - Ibn Abi Nasr narrated from Abdul Karim ibn Amr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who married a woman according to her own condition (by her terms), but he died before she could set the conditions.
Imam (as) said: "She is not entitled to a dowry (ṣadaq), but she inherits from him."
